race.comment: BEYOND THE REEF (3) resumes for her second campaign. Found them too sharp on debut when third over 1000m at Gosford last April. Has impressed in her two searching trials and looks to have strengthened over the break. PAILLERON (9) is a filly by Extreme Choice from Skate To Paris on debut for the Baker stable. Profiles well from the inside draw and makes plenty of appeal. SHANTI (10) three-year-old Ardrossan filly from Tears Of An Angel on debut for the Waterhouse & Bott yard. Trialled okay and gets every chance from the good gate. Has solid claims. CLINGER POWER (4) Overshare filly from a Star Witness mare on debut for the Ed O'Rourke stable. Placed in a recent trial over 900m at Rosehill and gets the services of Zac Lloyd. Keep safe.
